scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have to got a job to complete the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，你需要有职业才能完成此活动。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have already completed the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，你已经完成了此活动。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Greetings fellow lively human.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你好啊，活泼的人类。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Halloween is upon us and it is almost time to adventure out into places few dare go.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
万圣节到了，是时候去那些鲜有人敢涉足的地方冒险了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Trick or treat, which do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
不给糖就捣蛋，你更喜欢哪一个？

scripts.text: Trick
scripts.translation: 特里克

scripts.text: Treat
scripts.translation: 糖果

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a trick. Why don't you go pick a treat now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，你已经接受过特里克了。现在去选个糖果吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Give me a min...
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
稍等一下……

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Here is your treat. Your Base EXP has been slightly increased.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
这是给你的糖果。你的基础经验值略微增加了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I hope you enjoy your trick and Happy Halloween!
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
希望你喜欢这个特里克，万圣节快乐！

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a treat. Why don't you go pick a trick now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
抱歉，你已经领取过糖果了。现在去选个特里克吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Great! This shall be so much fun.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
太好了！这一定会非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Did you get the items I requested or do you need to see the list again?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你拿到我要求的物品了吗？还是需要再看一遍清单？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I will be sending you on a scavenger hunt for items.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我将派你去进行一场物品寻宝活动。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Bring back all the necessary items, and I will create you a treat.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
带回所有必要的物品，我会为你制作一份糖果。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Not just any normal treat either that you can eat, but it is something you can wear on your head.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
这可不是那种能吃的普通糖果，而是可以戴在头上的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
But with all things made, some items are required first.
The list:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
但在制作之前，需要先准备一些物品。
清单：
1个帽子，
30个南瓜，以及
20个<黑暗搜集者>宝石魔法布料

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Hurry along now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
赶快去吧。

scripts.text: Got'em
scripts.translation: 拿到了

scripts.text: Don't Have
scripts.translation: 还没有

scripts.text: See List
scripts.translation: 查看清单

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
You don't have enough items. Come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你的物品数量不足。凑齐后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Good job! I hope you are happy with your item.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
干得好！希望你对这件物品满意。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Enjoy the rest of your Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
享受你剩余的万圣节时光吧。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Go back out and search for them. Would you like to view the list?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
回去继续寻找它们吧。你想查看清单吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I require the following items:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我需要以下物品：
1个帽子，
30个南瓜，以及
20个<黑暗搜集者>宝石魔法布料。
